snippet.title: Procession Engine | Real-Time Tug-of-War Roguelike Deckbuilder | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Not another turn-based deckbuilder. Procession Engine is a real-time tug of war where your cards shape a whole army: your buildings spawn it and two lanes decide whose Stronghold falls first.

- Three races: Bloomwardens, Iron Concord, Hollow Choir
- Build a yard of buildings and link them with Accords
- Three acts of fights, bosses, shops and relics
- Online co-op for 2 or 3 players
- Ten Trials that twist the rules after every win

Out now in Early Access on Steam, with a free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4995080/
